coverage.summary: Applies to renting, buying, selling or securing financing for any housing in the City of Boston. The page states no unit-count, building-size, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits.

evidence.quoted_span: In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.
In the City of Boston, it’s illegal to discriminate when renting, buying, selling, or securing financing for any housing.

result.notes: I removed the claim that this rule complements G.L. c. 151B, § 4(10) from the summary. No document cites or quotes that statute. I changed supersedes_state_rule from false to null. D012 says only that the commission enforces 'local, state, and federal fair housing laws' and says nothing on precedence. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the page covers 'any housing' in Boston, not a class that assessor data cannot identify. D012 states no exemptions, so unverifiable_exemptions stays empty. D010 (DND Fair Chance policy), D011, D013 and D014 cover other subjects and do not bear on this rule's coverage.
